description: This file defines the CustomerOptionService interface, which provides methods for managing CustomerOption entities, such as listing options by store, saving or updating options, and retrieving options by code.

classes.name: CustomerOptionService
classes.description: An interface extending SalesManagerEntityService to manage CustomerOption entities, with additional methods specific to CustomerOption management such as listing by store, saving or updating options, and fetching by code.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Retrieves a list of CustomerOption entities associated with a specific store and language, potentially throwing a ServiceException.

methods.name: saveOrUpdate
methods.description: Saves a new CustomerOption entity or updates an existing one, may throw a ServiceException.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Retrieves a CustomerOption based on store and option code.
